This is an initial public offering of shares of the common stock of Alliance Laundry Holdings Inc.

We are offering 24,390,243 shares of our common stock, and our principal stockholder, BDT Capital Partners, LLC and its affiliated investment funds, is offering 13,170,731 shares of our common stock to be sold in this offering.

The initial public offering price per share will be $22.00

The underwriters have an option to purchase up to an additional 5,634,146 shares.
